title: The Popular teacher of the school
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：popular　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 popular 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the painter wrote of ① a popular teacher of the school in the catalogue, and everybody in the studio said at once that it was ② more popular than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the painter, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the popular ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most popular teacher of the school anybody in the studio had ever seen, or so the catalogue for May 1965 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too popular to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the popular ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a popular song of the summer, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as popular as the song of the summer they had once had in the old studio. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was popular or not, and he said so.

By 1978 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was ⑦ something popular, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next studio called the whole plan ⑧ quite popular; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the catalogue kept the names of the popular ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1981, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another popular teacher of the school in the same catalogue, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more popular than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most popular song of the summer in the whole studio, she said in 1983, was the one she could never quite name; the popular ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 受欢迎（前置定语 a popular teacher of the school：1971 年画师在展品目录里记下的那件受欢迎的老师）
B. adj. 受欢迎／流行（比较级 more popular than：文中两处，一处比学校里受欢迎的老师，一处比预想）
C. adj. 受欢迎／流行（最高级 the most popular：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 受欢迎（表语 too popular to do：母亲觉得它太受欢迎，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 流行（前置定语 a popular song of the summer：叔叔把整件事称作一桩流行的歌）
F. adj. 流行（同级比较 as popular as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩那年夏天流行的歌相比）
G. adj. 流行（后置定语 something popular：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 流行（受程度副词修饰 quite popular：那位观者的评价）

items.q: a popular teacher of the school
the most popular teacher of the school anybody
a popular song of the summer
The most popular song of the summer in

answers.why: popular 意为“受欢迎”，1971 年画师在展品目录里记下的是“一件受欢迎的老师”，此处作前置定语 a popular teacher of the school。
popular 意为“受欢迎”，此处用比较级 more popular than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
popular 意为“受欢迎”，展品目录上 五月 那行字说它是画室里最受欢迎的一件，故用最高级 the most popular teacher of the school。
popular 意为“受欢迎”，母亲认为这件东西“太受欢迎了，谁也用不上”，too popular to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
popular 意为“流行”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩流行的歌”，此处作前置定语 a popular song of the summer。
popular 意为“流行”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩那年夏天流行的歌一样流行”，同级比较用 as popular as。
popular 意为“流行”，展品目录上那半行字要的是“流行的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something popular。
popular 意为“流行”，邻画室来的那位观者认为这套计划“相当流行”，quite 修饰原级 popular。
popular 意为“流行”，1981 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要流行”，故用比较级 more popular than。
popular 意为“流行”，母亲 1983 年说的是“整个画室里最流行的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most popular song of the summer。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年，画师在展品目录里记下了一件受欢迎的老师。（a popular teacher of the school）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更受欢迎。（more popular than …）
母亲觉得它太受欢迎，谁也用不上。（too popular to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩流行的歌。（a popular song of the summer）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩那年夏天流行的歌一样流行。（as popular as …）
到了 1978 年，展品目录上只剩半行字：要的是一件流行的东西。（something popular）
answers: In 1971 the painter wrote of a popular teacher of the school in the catalogue.
Everybody said it was more popular than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too popular to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a popular song of the summer.
He said nobody would call it as popular as the song of the summer they had once had.
By 1978 the catalogue asked for nothing but something popular.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 popular 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the painter wrote of a popular teacher of the school in the catalogue, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most popular teacher of the school in the studio, or so the catalogue says.
My mother thought it too popular to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a popular song of the summer, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next studio called the plan quite popular, and everybody laughed.
The popular ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
